name: Psono Password Manager
description_en:
Psono is a credential manager offered as a hosted service or as software an organization runs on its own servers. A web, extension or mobile client encrypts vault data before sending it to the configured server. Self-hosting changes who operates that server; it does not remove the need to plan recovery and maintenance.

The documentation distinguishes clients from the server and allows selecting a different server before registration or login. Evaluate the intended deployment rather than assuming a public demo account proves compatibility with an internal installation.
description_zh:
Psono 可作为托管服务使用，也可由组织运行在自己的服务器。网页、扩展或移动客户端先加密保险库数据，再发送至配置的服务器。自托管改变服务器运维责任，并不会消除恢复与维护规划。

文档区分客户端和服务器，可在注册或登录前选择不同服务器。应评估实际部署，不能将公共演示账户视为内部安装兼容性的证明。

sections.en:
The getting-started guide begins with web registration and email activation. Initial encryption secrets are generated in the browser; the first login retrieves encrypted secrets and decrypts them using the password. A first entry is created from the datastore context menu, with folders and drag-and-drop organization. Imported exports provide a migration path but need field-by-field validation.

For a trial workflow, create a disposable website credential and a note, install an appropriate extension and check autofill against the intended site. The server setting matters: signing into the public service and signing into a company server are different account contexts. This example was not executed.
sections.zh:
入门指南从网页注册和邮件激活开始。浏览器生成初始加密秘密，首次登录取回加密秘密并用密码解密。通过数据存储区右键菜单创建首条记录，用文件夹和拖放整理。导入其他管理器的导出文件可供迁移，但需逐字段核对。

试用可创建可丢弃的网站凭据及笔记，安装适用扩展，核对目标站点填充。服务器设置很关键：公共服务和公司服务器是不同账户环境。此例未实际执行。

sections.title_en: Generate and retain the recovery code
sections.en:
The guide says a recovery code is the only recovery route after losing the password. Each account has at most one such code and generating another overwrites the existing code. It separately recommends a second factor. Recovery-code storage therefore belongs in initial setup rather than after an incident.

Client-side encryption is a documented design claim, not proof that a deployment is correctly secured. Administrators still need to validate server backups, upgrade procedures, email delivery and trusted client distribution. This research did not install the server, inspect key generation or test any recovery code.
sections.zh:
指南说明丢失密码后只能使用恢复码恢复。每账户最多一个恢复码，新生成的会覆盖旧码，并另行建议启用第二因素。因此保管恢复码应属于初始配置，不能等事故后补做。

客户端加密是文档中的设计说明，不能证明某次部署正确安全。管理员仍需验证服务器备份、升级、邮件送达和可信客户端分发。本文未安装服务器、检查密钥生成或测试恢复码。

sections.title_en: Separate hosting, edition rights and support
sections.title_zh: 区分托管、版本权益与支持
sections.en:
The homepage advertises all business features free for up to ten users and offers both on-premise and SaaS choices. Its pricing matrix did not expose a readable numeric paid tariff in the retrieved text; professional support and SLAs are quoted. Do not extrapolate the ten-user statement to unlimited free seats, every hosted arrangement or a support contract.

The vendor describes Psono as open source, but this reading did not inspect a repository license or map community and enterprise rights. Legal license status remains unverified in this record. A team evaluating self-hosting should include infrastructure, backups and administrator time in cost even when an edition has no license fee.
sections.zh:
首页宣传最多十名用户可免费使用全部商业功能，并提供本地部署与 SaaS。取得的价格表文本没有可读的付费数字，专业支持及 SLA 需报价。不能将十人说明扩展为无限免费席位、所有托管安排或支持合同。

厂商称 Psono 开源，但本文未检查仓库许可证或映射社区／企业权益，档案的法律许可状态仍未核实。评估自托管的团队即使无许可费，也应计入基础设施、备份和管理员时间。
